texts.preamble: Mukesh Munnilal Saroj vs The Sr Police Inspector And Anr on 1 April, 2026 Digitally signed by Laxmikant Laxmikant Gopal Gopal Chandan Chandan Date: 2026.04.02 11:42:52 +0530 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction Criminal Application No. 425 Of 2026 Mukesh Muniilal Saroj : Applicant.
texts.facts: 2. By the present Application, the Applicant is seeking to quash First Information Report bearing Crime No. 704 of 2025 dated 27 September 2025 for the offences punishable under Section 59 of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006 along with Sections 223, 274, 123 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, registered with Vinoba Bhave Nagar Police Station, Mumbai.
texts.arguments: Mr. Mateen Shaikh, learned Advocate for the Applicant submits that the issue involved in the present Criminal Application is pending for consideration before the Hon'ble Supreme Court. He further submits that similar issues are involved in Criminal Writ Petition Nos. 280 of 2025, 3444 of Mukesh Munnilal Saroj vs The Sr Police Inspector And Anr on 1 April, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5012995/ 1 2025 and 4078 of 2025. He refers to the orders passed in the above said Petitions, wherein this Court has admitted the same and granted interim reliefs. 4. Mrs. Rajeshree Newton, learned APP for the State/Respondent does not dispute that the issue involved in the present Criminal Application is subject matter of the Petitions, referred by the Applicant in the present Criminal Application. She submits that the present Criminal Application filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short "BNSS") be tagged along with the aforesaid Petitions and connected matters.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Mr. Mateen Shaikh, learned Advocate for the Applicant submits that the issue involved in the present Criminal Application is pending for consideration before the Hon'ble Supreme Court. He further submits that similar issues are involved in Criminal Writ Petition Nos. 280 of 2025, 3444 of Mukesh Munnilal Saroj vs The Sr Police Inspector And Anr on 1 April, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5012995/ 1 2025 and 4078 of 2025. He refers to the orders passed in the above said Petitions, wherein this Court has admitted the same and granted interim reliefs. 4. Mrs. Rajeshree Newton, learned APP for the State/Respondent does not dispute that the issue involved in the present Criminal Application is subject matter of the Petitions, referred by the Applicant in the present Criminal Application.
texts.respondent_arguments: She submits that the present Criminal Application filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short "BNSS") be tagged along with the aforesaid Petitions and connected matters.
